hypotheses.title: KT170 Extends Lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans
hypotheses.claim: Treatment with KT170 extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound increases mean and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Small molecules can modulate conserved longevity pathways such as stress resistance and nutrient sensing. A compound acting on these pathways should delay aging in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: KT170-treated nematodes will show significantly longer median and maximum lifespans than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one group with KT170 and one with vehicle, and measure survival on a defined schedule until all animals die, comparing lifespan curves statistically.

hypotheses.title: KT170 Extends Lifespan via Activation of DAF-2
hypotheses.claim: KT170 extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans by activating the insulin/IGF-1 receptor DAF-2. The lifespan extension requires DAF-2 signaling.
hypotheses.rationale: The insulin/IGF-1 receptor DAF-2 is a central regulator of aging whose signaling state shapes downstream longevity effectors. A compound acting through DAF-2 should show dependency on this receptor.
hypotheses.prediction: KT170 will extend lifespan in wild-type worms but fail to extend lifespan in daf-2 loss-of-function mutants.
hypotheses.experiment: Perform parallel lifespan assays in wild-type and daf-2 mutant worms treated with KT170 or vehicle, and test whether the lifespan extension is abolished in the mutant background.

hypotheses.title: Apple Extract Extends Lifespan Only at Toxic High Doses
hypotheses.claim: Apple extract extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans only at high doses that cause toxicity. The benefit emerges exclusively within a dose range that also produces adverse effects.
hypotheses.rationale: Mild stress from a toxicant can activate compensatory defense mechanisms that improve survival, a dose-dependent hormetic response. Lifespan extension should therefore coincide with doses producing measurable toxicity.
hypotheses.prediction: Apple extract will extend lifespan only at doses that concurrently reduce fertility, movement, or acute stress tolerance.
hypotheses.experiment: Perform lifespan assays across a dose series of apple extract alongside assays of fertility, motility, and acute stress survival, and test whether lifespan extension occurs only at doses showing toxicity.
